snippet.title: Eggstreme Farming Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Eggstreme Farming is a farming simulation game focused on the strategic raising of poultry, egg production, and financial management. Players start small and gradually expand their farm by unlocking new species, licenses, equipment, and economic systems such as loans and incubation.
